image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two bowls containing Asian-style shaved ice desserts. The bowl on the right features scoops of yellow and white ice cream (or condensed milk ice) atop shaved ice, garnished with red beans, cinnamon powder, and peanuts. The bowl on the left contains black tapioca pearls (boba), a block of white pudding or tofu, and clear jelly cubes in a sweet syrup. A bunch of yellow bananas is visible in the background.
